Strong diagonal muzzle-up presentation; support forearm reaches toward pistol grip base.
Support hand covers grip-base release; no separate cylinder opening or barrel break.
Support hand drops below grip; outgoing path partly hand/screen occluded.
Incoming long rectangular magazine is visible below grip in support hand. Canonical asset lacks this shaft and contains only magazine_base.
Magazine insertion toward grip; tip/seat boundary occluded behind fingers. Carrier remains canted up.

Weapon returns to aiming presentation. Canonical hip endpoint authored to local product transform; source continues aiming.
